svg.title: Trajectory encoder, controlled baselines, and residual completion control
svg.text: Implemented design: fixed causal windows, shared ACT core and an auxiliary-gradient control
Persistent point identities within each window
Resample identities across windows, retain identity across time
Every condition uses current RGB and current joint state
T = 16 at stride 3, 90 Hz. Predict 100 joint targets in every condition.
History-enabled variants share the RGB window. GT point tracks are privileged inputs.
Same actor inputs and architecture in both variants
Connected: auxiliary gradients reach shared observation encoders.
Detached: the auxiliary head learns, with its memory input detached.
